verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only covers OpenTofu's IaC workflow (plan/apply/destroy), state encryption, and provider ecosystem — none of it addresses user-data retention/deletion controls for an AI-native user (e.g., telemetry, usage data, account data policies). While `tofu destroy` and state encryption touch infrastructure state security, there's no evidence of any mechanism letting a user control retention or deletion of their own interaction/data as a consumer of the tool.
